item.title: Missile Barrage in Israel, Woman Killed in Tel Aviv
item.description: A woman was killed and at least 20 others were injured late Motzei Shabbos after an Iranian missile barrage struck central Israel, directly hitting residential buildings in Tel Aviv. Full Story, Photos, Video

item.title: Leader of Iran Khamenei Dead Following Israel, US Strike on Iran
item.description: President Donald Trump confirmed on Saturday afternoon Iranian Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei is dead, claiming the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) are seeking immunity from the U.S. Full Story, Photos, Video

item.title: Israel Declares State of Emergency as Iran Fires Missiles at Israel
item.description: Israel moved into a state of emergency on Shabbos after Iran launched missiles toward the country in response to U.S. and Israeli strikes on Iran; commercial flights suspended and schools are closed. Full Story
